Profile

About Rayyan

I am an international relations and international development professional whose record has been built at the intersection of strategic communication, programme and project coordination, and development practice across three institutional settings since 2023: inside two divisions of Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, inside a strategic international NGO, and through a postgraduate programme built around applied project design and strategic communication.

I currently serve as Projects Intern and NGOs Coordinator at MANGOma, coordinating a nine-country partner portfolio spanning Cameroon, Colombia, Zimbabwe, Kenya, Switzerland, Madagascar, Uganda, Nigeria, and Malawi. The substance of the role is partner engagement, donor stewardship, and capacity building delivered as one connected function: a seven-module NGO Fundraising and Bid-Writing Toolkit deployed across every partner, a 211-entry international funding intelligence database converting fragmented donor information into targeted strategy, and governance-level engagement with the Board of Trustees across four structured check-ins that shaped the organisation’s 2026 capacity-building workshop programme.

Before that I worked in the United Nations Division of Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, contributing to Pakistan’s climate policy representation at COP29 under the direct supervision of the Assistant Director. I researched, drafted, and analysed four policy briefs on the New Collective Quantified Goal and the Green Climate Fund, coordinated documentation and operational logistics for Pakistan’s facilitation of the SCO Islamabad Summit 2024, and engaged formally with diplomats and senior officials from more than seventeen countries. Earlier, in the Iran and Turkey Division, I coordinated the Pakistan-Türkiye 75 Years of Diplomatic Relations Conference convening more than fifty diplomats and senior officials.

I am completing an MA in Global Development at the University of East Anglia, holding Distinctions in Project Design and Management, Contemporary World Development, and Globalisation, Business and Development. As Project Director for Nile Bridge Partners, an academic South Sudan humanitarian simulation serving conflict-affected youth in Bor South County, Jonglei State, I directed a GBP 2 million Humanitarian, Development and Peace Nexus proposal, personally writing the executive summary, logframe, and results framework while leading a multi-functional team of six. I hold the UEA Gold, Silver, and Bronze Awards and am an active UEA Award Fellow.

Side Project

The Chronicles

Visit The Chronicles

https://rayyan200103.github.io/THE-CHRONICLE/

Imagine you are moving through thousands of years in time while seeing all the events around you unfold, in every part of the world in their own beauty as you scroll through vertically and horizontally, with the insight of comparative religion, international relations, philosophy and discovery combined with history, consisting of in-depth and dense data within each cell that you will open. Having the dual calendar architecture and an immense directory of references within the cells, I came up with the idea of “The Chronicles” after having a chat with a very close friend of mine on the 5th of April, 2026 at his new place in Norwich, England.

I told him “I wished there was a website that could potentially showcase all the major events of the history and a curious person can understand it all by just looking at that one platform”. From there The Chronicles emerged, and after countless hours working on it, reading relevant books, authentic data and researching the best I possibly could, I built this in its very dynamic way that it is today. Now with multiple hyperlinks, and also a separate website fully integrating the depths of all the major events that unfolded “Before Adam”.

Please have a look yourself and give me your kind feedback.
